duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا سَمِعْنَا مُنَادِيًا يُنَادِي لِلْإِيمَانِ أَنْ ءَامِنُوا بِرَبِّكُمْ فَقَامَنَّا رَبَّنَا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرْ عَنَّا سَيِّئَاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ الْأَبْرَارِ رَبَّنَا وَمَاتِنَا مَا وَعَدَتْنَا عَلَى رُسُلِكَ وَلَا تُخْزِنَا يَوْمَ الْقِيمَةِ إِنَّكَ لَا تُخْلِفُ الْمِيعَادَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbanaa innanaa saminaa munaadiyai yunaadee lil eemaani an aaminoo bi Rabbikum fa aamannaa; Rabbanaa faghfir lanaa zunoobanaa wa kaffir 'annaa saiyi aatina wa tawaffanaa ma'al abraar. Rabbanaa wa aatinaa maa wa'attanaa 'alaa Rusulika wa laa tukhzinaa Yawmal Qiyaamah; innaka laa tukhliful mee'aad
duas.translation: Our Lord! we have heard the call of one calling (Us) to Faith, 'Believe ye in the Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord! Forgive us our sins, blot out from us our iniquities, and take to Thyself our souls in the company of the righteous. Our Lord! Grant us what Thou didst promise unto us through Thine messengers, and save us from shame on the Day of Judgment: For Thou never breakest Thy promise.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ هَبْ لِي حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ وَاجْعَل لِّي لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِي الْآخِرِينَ وَاجْعَلْنِي مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ النَّعِيمِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi hab lee hukman wa alhiqnee bis saaliheen. Waj'al lee lisaana sidqin fil aakhireen. Waj'alnee min warasati Jannatin Na'eem
duas.translation: O my Lord! bestow wisdom on me, and join me with the righteous; Grant me honourable mention on the tongue of truth among the latest (generations); Make me one of the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss.

duas.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ مَالِكِ يَوْمِ الدِّينِ إِيَّاكَ نَعْبُدُ وَإِيَّاكَ نَسْتَعِينُ اهْدِنَا الصِّرَاطَ الْمُسْتَقِيمَ صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
duas.transliteration: Bismillahir Rahmanir Raheem. Alhamdu lillaahi Rabbil 'Aalameen. Ar-Rahmaanir-Raheem. Maaliki Yawmid-Deen. Iyyaka na'budu wa iyyaka nasta'een. Ihdinas-Siraatal-Mustaqeem. Siraatal-lazeena an'amta 'alaihim ghayril-maghdoobi 'alaihim wa lad-daaalleen
duas.translation: In the name of Allah, Most Gracious, Most Merciful. Praise be to Allah, the Cherisher and Sustainer of the worlds; Most Gracious, Most Merciful; Master of the Day of Judgment. Thee do we worship, and Thine aid we seek. Show us the straight way, the way of those on whom Thou hast bestowed Thy Grace, not (the way) of those who earn Thine anger, nor of those who go astray.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ قَدْ آتَيْتَنِي مِنَ الْمُلْكِ وَعَلَّمْتَنِي مِن تَأْوِيلِ الْأَحَادِيثِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ أَنتَ وَلِيِّي فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ تَوَفَّنِي مُسْلِمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِي بِالصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi qad aataytanee minal mulki wa 'allamtanee min ta'wilil ahaadeeth. Faatiras-samawati wal-ard. Anta waliyyi fid-dunya wal-akhirah. Tawaffanee muslimaan wa alhiqnee bis-saaliheen
duas.translation: O Thou Creator of the heavens and the earth! Thou art my Protector in this world and in the Hereafter. Take my soul (at death) as one submitting to Thy will (as a Muslim), and unite me with the righteous.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَدْخِلْنِي بِرَحْمَتِكَ فِي عِبَادِكَ الصَّالِحِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'mataka allatee an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala waalidayya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa adkhilnee birahmatika fee 'ibaadikas-saaliheen
duas.translation: O my Lord! grant me that I may be grateful for Thy favour which Thou hast bestowed upon me and my parents, and that I may work righteousness that will please Thee, and admit me, by Thy Grace, among Thy righteous servants.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا أَصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا إِنَّهَا سَاءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
duas.transliteration: Rabbana asrif 'annaa 'azaaba Jahannama inna 'azaabaha kaana gharaamaa innahaa saaat mustaqarran wa muqaaam
duas.translation: Our Lord! avert from us the Wrath of Hell, for its Wrath is indeed an affliction grievous; Evil indeed is it as an abode, and as a place to rest in.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا إِنَّنَا آمَنَّا فَاغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana innanaa aamannaa faghfir lanaa dhunoobanaa wa qinaa 'azaaba an-naar
duas.translation: Our Lord! We have indeed believed; forgive us our sins, and save us from the torment of the Fire.

duas.arabic: رَبَّنَا ابْنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
duas.transliteration: Rabbana aatina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qinaa 'azaaba an-naar
duas.translation: Our Lord! Give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from the torment of the Fire.

duas.arabic: رَبِّ أَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أَشْكُرَ نِعْمَتَكَ الَّتِي أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيَّ وَعَلَى وَالِدَيَّ وَأَنْ أَعْمَلَ صَالِحًا تَرْضَاهُ وَأَصْلِحْ لِي فِي ذُرِّيَّتِي إِنِّي تُبْتُ إِلَيْكَ وَإِنِّي مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
duas.transliteration: Rabbi awzi'nee an ashkura ni'mataka allatee an'amta 'alayya wa 'ala waalidayya wa an a'mala saalihan tardaahu wa aslih lee fee zurriyyatee; innee tubtu ilaika wa innee minal muslimeen
duas.translation: O my Lord! Grant me that I may be grateful for Thy favour which Thou hast bestowed upon me and my parents, and that I may work righteousness which Thou mayest approve; and make my descendants righteous. Truly I have turned to Thee, and truly I am among the Muslims.
